Change in Intelligence: If Intelligence goes down or up for any reason and the change is relatively permanent, the magic-user must check known spells again by level group using the procedure above.

Acquisition of Heretofore Unknown Spells: Although the magic-user must stop checking after the first complete check of each spell in a level group, or immediately when the minimum number knowable is reached during successive checks, additional previously unknown spells may still be acquired up to the Intelligence-based maximum. They may come from captured or otherwise acquired spellbooks or from scrolls; a scroll is destroyed in learning and knowing the spell or spells.
